articleTitle: Early Detection and Classification of Melanoma Based on Android MobileNet V2 Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Melanoma is a malignant form of cancer that affects the skin and has a particularly high mortality rate, so it requires early detection to increase the level of safety for users. Diagnosis and detection of skin cancer are usually done through manual screening and visual inspection. This process requires a long time, has high complexity, is subjective, and is prone to errors. CNN is one of the algorithms with advantages in accurate classification. In this research, early detection and classification of melanoma cancer were carried out based on two classes, namely benign and malignant using the Convolutional Neural Network method. Our proposed method yields an accuracy of 81.11% for the validation data. The accuracy results obtained can be improved by using more datasets and increasing the number of layers used. This study uses the CNN method using MobileNet V2 architecture to detect melanoma skin cancer. The class used is benign and malignant.

articleTitle: Early Ischemic Stroke Detection Using Deep Learning: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain causes cell death and causes the brain to stop functioning properly. There are two types of strokes, which is ischemic and hemorrhagic. One of the techniques for early stroke detection is Computerized Tomography (CT) scan. The purpose of this paper is to gather information or answer related to this paper’s research question. Our research will be more focused on finding the most effective technique with technologies such as deep learning and machine learning to detect early ischemic stroke. Reviewing and gathering a conclusion from these papers are the methods which will be used in this paper. To conduct a literature review, we will use Systematic Literature Review method to filter research papers that are related to our topic and are matched with the keywords. This research came to a conclusion of the best datasets to use for deep learning in predicting ischemic stroke are MRI images and CT scan images, and the method with the best accuracy is Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

articleTitle: Classification of Dental Caries Level Using Conjugate Gradient Backpropagation Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Oral diseases are among the most prevalent noncommunicable diseases, affecting approximately 3.5 billion individuals globally. Untreated caries of primary and permanent teeth, severe periodontal disease, edentulism (total tooth loss), and lip and oral cavity cancer are the most burdensome oral diseases and conditions. Untreated dental caries is the most prevalent noncommunicable disease and a significant global public health concern, accounting for approximately 2 billion cases of all oral diseases. Several studies have shown that machine learning can help read patient conditions more quickly and accurately. This research designs a classification system using Multi-Layer Perceptron to determine the level of dental caries. The dental image consists of four dental caries levels, then extracted using a Gabor filter. Multi-Layer Perceptron performance in classifying dental caries levels shows promising results. Conjugate Gradient Backpropagation with Powell-Beale Restarts and Conjugate Gradient Backpropagation with Fletcher-Reeves Updates were used for the classification stage. The training result shows that Conjugate Gradient Backpropagation with Fletcher-Reeves Updates has a better accuracy average than Conjugate Gradient Backpropagation with Powell-Beale Restarts. The highest accuracy achieved by Conjugate Gradient Backpropagation with Powell-Beale Restarts is 96,5%.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Service Quality in Human Resource Information Systems Using the ISO/IEC 25010
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Currently, the use of information systems is very important to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of a service process. Surabaya State University has implemented a Human Resource Information System to facilitate service processes and monitoring in the field of human resources online. Given the importance of using the Human Resource Information System, it is necessary to evaluate the quality of the system based on functional suitability and usability, which aims to determine the advantages and disadvantages of the system from user experience so that it can be used as material for evaluating the quality of information systems. ISO/IEC 25010 is an international standard for evaluating information systems, using ISO/IEC 25010 to evaluate the quality of information systems using product quality, where the process refers to the characteristics of an information system product. The purpose of this study was to evaluate the quality of the Human Resource Information System based on ISO/IEC 25010. The research method used is a descriptive quantitative approach. Assessment is carried out on five main menus: Proposals for Further Studies, Proposals for Leave, Promotions, Proposals for Inclusion of Degrees, and Proposals for Retirement. The assessment process is based on a questionnaire designed using the functional and usability sub-characteristics of the aspects of the system being assessed. The results showed that the highest score for each sub-characteristic, namely, the Completeness, Correctness, and Appropriateness sub-characteristics, was obtained on the Leave Proposal menu by 92%, 83%, and 90%. In contrast, the Learnability, Operability, and User Interface Aesthetics sub-characteristics were obtained on the Retirement Proposal menu by 81%, 88%, and 83%.

articleTitle: Fertilizer Quality Detection For Purple Sweet Potato Plants Using YOLOv4-Tiny
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Fertilizer is a planting medium used to meet the needs of plants to produce well and produce quality results. This study chose fertilizer. It is essential for plants for quality results. In addition, organic fertilizers are not only beneficial for plants. Still, they can also improve land quality for the future and even reduce environmental pollution with the great benefits of fertilizer for plants. It is miserable for purple sweet potato farmers to give the wrong fertilizer to plants because it affects the quality and increases the number of yields. Therefore it is necessary to detect the quality of fertilizer for purple sweet potatoes using the YOLOv4-tiny. The purpose of the research is to make a fertilizer detection system for purple sweet potatoes using YOLOv4-tiny and to analyze the performance of YOLOv4-tiny in detecting the quality of fertilizer for plants. It can be concluded that the fertilizer testing process using the YOLOv4-tiny method obtained a relatively high mAP value, starting with worm manure having an mAP result of 0.69 on grade_a. The worm manure with grade_b has an mAP value of 0.55. Then for mineral fertilizers, in grade_a, it has an mAP value of 0.75. The mineral fertilizers on grade_b have an mAP value of 0.69. The testing process on husk fertilizer, in grade_a, has an mAP result of 0.69, and in grade_b. It has an mAP value of 0.55.

articleTitle: Hybrid Encryption Based on Fernet and Rivest Shamir Adleman (RSA)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: RSA is an asymmetric encryption algorithm that uses two different keys, a public key to encrypt the plain text and a private key to decrypt the cipher text. Fernet is a symmetric encryption algorithm that uses a single key to encrypt and decrypt information. This study uses Fernet and RSA which is the combination of symmetric and asymmetric encryption called hybrid encryption. In addition, the cipher text will be hidden inside an image using Stepic. Hybrid Encryption uses asymmetric encryption to encrypt the symmetric encryption secret key, it will secure the symmetric encryption. The result of this study is the lowest error that we got as the MSE is 0.00% and is inversely proportional with the Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Avalanche (AVA) with 79.00% and 42.34% in order. Inversely proportional to the length of the text that is hidden in the image, the longest text that is hidden, the more changes that we get in the image with the highest Unified Average Changing Intensity (UACI) and Number of Pixels Change Rate (NPCR) with the biggest image size with 46.48% for UACI and 99.86% for the NPCR.

articleTitle: Investigating the Tourist Visit Intention During Covid 19 Pandemic Using Mood Management Theory (MMT) of Virtual Reality (VR) Tourism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Virtual Reality Technology for tourism (VR Tourism) can be a means to boost tourist visits. However, this opinion is still controversial. VR Tourism, as a VR technology, provides a pleasant experience for its users and is supposed to encourage people to visit a tourist site. As a result, evaluating VR tourism's effectiveness in mood management becomes critical. This study develops a research model on how Mood Management Theory (MMT) influences visit intentions. This study uses an experimental approach by providing an experience using VR Tourism Making Batik with natural dyes. The data were analyzed using a path analysis approach processed using SmartPLS 3.0. The findings indicate that Entertainment Experience, Education Experience, Esthetic Experience, and favourably impact the perception of positive mood enhancement. However, the intention to visit does not display any significant association with the perception of positive mood improvement.

articleTitle: Review of Time Series Classification Techniques and Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In order to spot trends in the methodologies and procedures employed, this systematic literature review will look at works on time series categorization. Six research questions are used as a guide to perform a systematic literature evaluation based on the PICOC criteria. In order to find articles that fit the required criteria, a search is done through trustworthy article database providers. One article from the collection was picked as the main one, which will be used to find further articles with information that is similar. A search based on the main article turned up 115 linked articles. According to the systematic literature review's findings, there were 28 articles on time series categorization in 2020, but only 19 by mid-May 2023. This suggests a high rate of publishing, illustrating the academics' interest in the study of time series categorization. Time series classification research articles are regularly published in the Springer Publisher magazine Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, followed by IEEE Access. Public datasets that are utilized as experimental datasets often at rates of 35% and 10%, respectively, include the UCR archive and the UAE archive. This shows that experiments regularly use UCR datasets as references. Over the last five years, deep learning has been the subject of 30% of research papers, while random convolutional has contributed 14% of publications and is a promising research trend. Time series can be categorized using methods based on similarity, interval, shapelet, dictionary, deep learning, random convolution, and combination.

articleTitle: Evaluation Metrics of Water Meter Reading with Optical Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Water plays big role in our daily life. In Indonesia, to supply clean water to people, there are water providers which may owned by state through local government, private company or community. This study put attention in the water meter recording process that is done manually and prone to error due to double bookkeeping. One of the solutions is by implementing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to read water meter. This study considers this approach offer certain flexibility since the change and cost is limited. However, most research in water meter reader evaluate their performance only with accuracy. This study proposes other evaluation metrics such as Character Error Rate (CER), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) to complement accuracy. By using those metrics to evaluate the prototype in this study produces these results accuracy of 84.8%, CER 15.6%, MAPE 0.2% and RMSE 122. Using the metrics, the study concludes that the prototype has good pre-processing and post-processing but not good enough recognition. The high number of RMSE also suggest that the prototype has potential to give disadvantage to both customer and provider. This study concludes that in water meter reader with OCR, accuracy metric alone is not enough to measure the performance of the system. CER and RMSE may help to give better insight to the performance of the water meter reader. The study also shows that RMSE has high sensitivity to outlier. In this study, removal of one outlier reduces the RMSE by 87%.

articleTitle: Three Winding Transformer Evaluation of K-Factor Value and Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: It is impossible to completely eliminate harmonics from the electric power supply. Harmonic distortion waves are produced by the nonlinear load. On the other hand, due to the fact that the harmonic current flows through the transformer winding, the presence of harmonics causes an abnormally high increase in temperature inside the transformer. It is possible to utilise the rise in the K-factor value of the transformer as a representation of the increase in heat. In order to reduce harmonic distortion and the transformer K-factor value, the author of this article proposes using a detuned reactor in conjunction with a shunt harmonic passive filter. Three-winding transformer is the one that is being utilised. To compare the reduction in harmonic distortion and the K-factor value, many situations are required. The first case study involves harmonics and assumes that no harmonic filter has been installed. In the second scenario, a shunt harmonic passive filter is used to cut down on the amount of harmonic distortion as well as the K-factor value. The third option combines a detuned reactor with a shunt harmonic passive filter in order to accomplish the same goal as the second scenario. The values of THD_I and THD_V for the first scenario are 20.62 percent and 27.83 percent, respectively. while the value of the K-factor is 4.46. The THD_I and THD_V values for the second scenario are, respectively, 10.66% and 15.39%. In the meanwhile, the value of the K factor is 2.92. Regarding the second scenario, the THD_I and THD_V values come in at 2.82% and 4.91%, respectively. while the value of the K-factor is 1.13. When compared to the other scenarios, the third one achieves the greatest results in terms of reducing harmonic distortion and K-factor to the lowest possible levels. The shunt harmonic passive filter's effectiveness may be enhanced by the presence of a detuned reactor.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review: Diagnosing Pneumonia Through X-Ray Images Using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Pneumonia is an infectious disease affecting human lungs, it majorly affects the elderly and may be life-threatening in some cases. The World Health Organization or WHO reported that in India, one in three deaths is caused due to pneumonia. Early diagnosis of Pneumonia will save many human lives. Due to the success of deep learning algorithms in analyzing images, there are so many algorithms for pneumonia detection now. This paper aims to analyze and evaluate the accuracy of the deep learning algorithm and its application on detecting or diagnosing pneumonia from chest x-ray images. This paper used a systematic literature review approach on several papers found on Google Scholar using a keyword-based search mechanism related to pneumonia detection and deep learning. The authors compare each method from the papers and sort it with accuracy as the parameter. The method with the highest accuracy is the AlexNet model with the accuracy of 99.62%. Automation of pneumonia detection using a deep learning model is possible, however a doctor’s supervision is still necessary to prevent a case of misdiagnose.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Model in the Hospitality Industry to Increase Traceability and Transparency of Transactions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The hotel industry is a service industry that involves many parties to provide satisfactory service to hotel customers. Customers find it difficult to ensure all the services they receive are worth the money they incur. In the current hospitality system, customers cannot track the food ingredients they consume according to the standards they pay for, hotel customers cannot know hotel facilities, and the security system is supported by quality equipment. The above difficulties can be solved with a transparent supply chain system. Blockchain technology, with its advantages, has the potential to be adopted in the supply chain of hotel products to make it more transparent and easier to track. Supply chain management is greatly aided by blockchain technology, which is a distributed database that permits safe, transparent, and tamper-resistant record keeping from the point of origination of the items to the point of consumption by the hotel guest. We propose a model to transform hotel industry supply chain business processes into transparent and accountable workflows. In addition, an application was developed to enable every stakeholder in the supply chain to contribute to data collection and monitor the status of each stage in the industrial hotel supply chain. The research method is divided into three stages, namely understanding the hotel industry's business processes, model construction, and application prototyping development. The experimental results show several obstacles, ranging from technological readiness to the standardization of systems by hotel stakeholders that support the implementation of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: KNN Algorithm Optimization in GLCM-Based Beef and Pork Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Beef is the most consumed meat by the people of Indonesia. The increase in beef prices that are getting higher from year to year makes beef producers commit fraud, namely by mixing beef with beef. This makes consumers feel aggrieved and get meat that is not as expected. So a system is needed to solve the problem, which is able to distinguish the type of beef and the type of pork. Therefore, this study proposes a method used to identify pork and beef based on imagery. There are several stages to identify pork and beef, namely by segmenting or separating objects with the background. The Otsu method is used for the segmentation process. Objects that have been segmented are carried out the extraction process of RGB and HSV color characteristics. Then proceed with the feature extraction process with GLCM. The classification process is carried out with the KNN algorithm with the best K value search optimization using the Elbow method. The results showed that this study was able to identify pork and beef with a testing accuracy of 91.66%. While the most optimal K value is obtained using the Elbow method of K = 7 with an error value = 0.08. The highest score for recall at K=7 was 88.79%, the highest value for precision was 97.17% at K=7, and the highest score for F1 Score was 92.79% at K=7.

articleTitle: Exploring Ingest Pattern of University Students Living At Home And Away From Homes: A Case of Kumaun Region
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The intent of the research is to interrogate the differences in food consumption patterns between university students who live at home and those who live away from home in India's Kumaun region, using a qualitative approach. The study will gather data through interviews and focus groups with both groups of students, totaling 400 undergraduate and postgraduate students from private and government universities aged between 17 and 26 years. An online questionnaire will be used to collect data on how the student’s eating habits are influenced by their families, friends, and the availability of food. Furthermore, the study's qualitative approach will enable the researchers to gather rich and nuanced data that can notify the occurrence of certain interventions to improve the dietary habits of students. Collectively, this exploration has the potential to frame a expressive offering to our comprehension of the nutritive customs of university students in India's Kumaun region. By providing insights into the factors that influence food consumption patterns among these students and will furnish wisdom for policy maker both in state level and central level to promote healthier eating habits and overall well-being within the student population residing in Kumaun region.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of Sarcasm Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Sarcasm is an expression that, at first glance, has a positive connotation, but if you pay close attention, it will have a negative meaning or vice versa. This research was conducted to find out research trends related to sarcasm detection carried out by previous researchers by collecting various articles that were used as qualitative data. This study uses a bibliometric analysis approach, which consists of five stages of research: determining search keywords, initial search results, refinement of search results, compiling initial data statistics, and data analysis. The results of the research that has been conducted show that from year to year, research related to the detection of sarcasm continues to increase, with the highest number of articles in 2022 being as many as 145. Based on bibliometric analysis, the current research trend is "improving," which means enabling researchers to improve algorithms, methods, and models.

articleTitle: Exploring XGBoost as an Effective Machine Learning Algorithm for Stellar Spectral Data Classification in Astronomy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The discipline of astronomy has experienced a substantial metamorphosis due to the advent of contemporary telescopes, which facilitate the accumulation of extensive spectral information. The processing of data through traditional manual means has become unfeasible owing to its vast volume, thereby necessitating the adoption of automated classification. The advent of machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence has enabled the efficient and accurate processing of spectral data, thereby facilitating a more comprehensive analysis of celestial objects. Prior research has investigated the efficacy of diverse machine learning algorithms in the context of stellar classification endeavors, as well as the significance of pre-processing spectral data. The present investigation centers on the utilization of XGBoost, a machine learning algorithm that exhibits the ability to handle heterogeneous data types and address imbalanced datasets, thus rendering it a viable option for classification endeavors. In this research, we found that Random Forest and XGBoost gave good result compared to other classifier. In contrast, reduction dimension using PCA are lowering the achieved result.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Oversampling Methods on Deep Learning-Based Skin Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The field of dermatology faces considerable challenges when it comes to early detection of skin cancer. Our study focused on using different datasets, including original data, augmented data, and SMOTE oversampled data, to identify skin cancer. Our dataset consisted of images of skin lesions from the MNIST Skin Cancer dataset (HAM 10000), including samples of both cancerous and benign cases in the dataset. We employed data augmentation to expand the dataset’s size and increase the diversity of skin lesion features. Furthermore, to tackle class imbalance in the dataset, we applied the SMOTE oversampling technique to generate synthetic samples for the under-represented group. With the original, augmented, and SMOTE oversampled datasets, we trained a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. The performance of the model was evaluated using accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score. The comparison between the results obtained from the original data, augmented data, and SMOTE oversampling data clearly revealed distinctions in performance. Our findings clearly demonstrate that employing data augmentation and SMOTE oversampling can significantly enhance the efficacy of skin cancer detection.

articleTitle: Classifying Student Achievement Using K-NN Based on Feature Normalization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The existence of students' achievement classification with high performance is very important to support teachers in the evaluation of the process of learning. However, not much research has addressed this issue. Accordingly, our research concentrate on the establishment of a classification model for students' achievement with high performance. To achieve this goal, we explore three feature normalization techniques (feature standardized, feature scaled, and feature centered), which are combined with the K-NN method. The K-NN parameters are set with Euclidean distances and the number of neighbors 2, 4, and 6.Furthermore, the evaluation technique uses cross-validation with 2, 3, 5, 10, and 20 folds. The experimental results reveal that the combination of both normalization techniques and K-NN produces the best performance in terms of average accuracy, namely: Standard_K-NN and Scale_K-NN about 84.52% by the number of neighbor = 2. This shows that both techniques are more appropriate to the characteristic of our student data, which is indicated by their accuracy average outperforming the Center_K-NN method by 1.2%.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Number of Pixels Change Rate (NPCR) in Symetric Cryptography Based on Data Encryption Standard (DES)

abstract: Data Encryption Standard (DES) is a symmetric encryption algorithm that uses a single key to encrypt and decrypt information. In addition, the cipher text will be hidden inside an image using Stepic. DES Encryption use symmetric encryption to encrypt and decryption to decrypt. It will secure the symmetric encryption and maintain the speed of the encryption and decryption. Inversely proportional to the length of the text that is hidden in the image, the longest text that is hidden, the more changes that we get in the image with the highest Unified Average Changing Intensity (UACI) and Number of Pixels Change Rate (NPCR) with the biggest image size with 43.47% for UACI and 99.87% for the NPCR.

articleTitle: The Strategy for Increasing the Exchange Rate of Traditional Erorejo Fishermen Using the Fuzzy Transform and Fuzzy Times Series Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: After the COVID-19 pandemic, several regional problems emerged in the Erorejo freshwater fisherman group in Indonesia, namely the difficulty in marketing freshwater fish products and the production of floating cage cultivation has decreased by 30-35%. This study aims to increase the exchange rate of Erorejo freshwater fishermen by using the Fuzzy Transform and Fuzzy Times Series methods. We determine patterns and historical data series and extrapolate these patterns as predictions of future conditions. The prediction process is carried out to reduce errors and is used for decision-making in planning activities for future freshwater fish fishermen's welfare. The results showed that the prediction results with the Fuzzy Transform and Fuzzy Time Series approaches obtained the smallest error values at order 6 MAPE of 0.271%, d1 0.273, and d2 0.996. On average, the predicted results of freshwater fishermen's exchange rate using this method at Order 6 are in the fairly high growth category. This shows an increase compared to before using this method, namely the exchange rate of freshwater fishermen in the medium category.

articleTitle: Analysis of Loads Effect on Neutral Current of Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: One of distribution transformer’s function is to convert high voltage electrical energy to low voltage levels. This study analyzing 3 phase distribution transformers with 20/400 volts level which directly supplies Talun region in PLN Rayon Wlingi. PLN or known as State Electricity Company in Indonesia is a company which support and maintain the supply of electricity, especially in generation, transmission and distribution. In actual conditions each phase loads are hard to exactly balanced, these unbalanced loads in three phase creates a neutral current to flow. Neutral current as the vector sum of three phase currents in a symmetrical component. Unbalanced loads can also occur under normal and overload conditions. Overload generates heat and losses that occur in transformer, especially on transformer’s core and transformer’s windings. This study also analyzes the effect of the transformer’s load on the loss and heat of transformer. According to PLN’s distribution transformer management regulations, the maximum distribution transformer loading is 80% of the full load current, while for maximum load imbalance is 25%. Result show that the greater the unbalanced load the greater the value of the neutral current. At the morning Talun feeder has 4 transformers which on bad unbalanced load condition, and at the afternoon it has 3 transformers on bad unbalanced load condition (25% and over). The purpose of this research is to know the characteristic loads on Talun feeder, PLN Rayon Wlingi, so the result of this research can be used to planning the distribution system of PLN Rayon Wlingi on the newest loads and to provide an opportunity for other researchers to further analyze the character of the load and its impact on neutral current, loss and temperature of transformer.

articleTitle: Performance Management of Information Technology Governance in Malaysian Public Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The success of higher education institutions (HEI) in Malaysia depends on the efficient and effective use of information technology (IT) which is essential to support research, teaching, and management. This study aims to obtain the customer’s perspective on the IT system infrastructure and services and develop a research model for the performance management of IT governance in Malaysian public HEI. Survey data from 106 academic staff and students at Malaysian public HEIs were collected and analyzed using Microsoft Excel. It also identifies factors associated with customers’ IT backgrounds and perspectives in order to develop a research model for the performance management of IT governance in Malaysian public HEI. Findings from this study demonstrate a positive customer perspective on the usefulness, satisfaction, and quality of the IT infrastructure and services in Malaysian public HEI using the updated Information System Success (ISS) model. This study’s outcome can guide future efforts to improve IT governance and support research, teaching, and management in Malaysian public HEI.

articleTitle: Implementation K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm Skin Diseases Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Skin diseases are skin disorders caused by germs, fungi, parasites, viruses, or due to infections that can attack anyone, skin diseases can attack part or all of the skin of the sufferer which of course can endanger the condition. The health of the sufferer is not treated seriously. Several factors can cause skin disorders, namely living factors, environment, unhealthy living habits, allergies, and climate including one factor that is often encountered, and there are many other factors. This study will analyze and classify data using existing variables using mining fund algorithms and will be processed with machine learning. The method used by researchers is K-Nearest Neighbor. In the classification of K-Nearest Neighbor, there is a good k value for the algorithm depending on the amount of data. A high k value will generally reduce the effect of noise on classification. And the results of the classification are used as a reference for making skin disease detection applications.

articleTitle: Post-Stroke Therapy Design Based on ROM Classification and Angle Accuracy of Stroke Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Stroke is a chronic disease that can have a dangerous impact and cause circulatory disorders in the brain so it experiences blockage of arterial blood that comes from blood deposits in blood vessels. A ruptured blood vessel that affects the blood vessel wall results in a reduced supply of nutrients and oxygen to the brain which causes damage to brain tissue. stroke can result in disability and death in the sufferer. so far, stroke treatment still relies on therapists who carry out therapy in a conventional manner. based on the increasing data on stroke patients, the purpose of this study is to facilitate the therapist in conducting post-stroke therapy, so that the therapist does not move the patient's hand manually and the therapy results can be seen in real-time. This Post-Stroke Therapy Tool is controlled using a microcontroller based on the arduino Mega 2560 Microcontroller using a Power Window motor as a flexion-extension arm drive, and an RDS3235 Motor as a finger drive, and uses an Internet of Things (IoT) System to monitor the progress of therapy in post-stroke patients. This tool can perform flexion-extension movements with 3 angles, namely 30, 45, and 90. In this post-stroke therapy tool, there are several constituent components including the use of dc motors (power window motors and RDS3235 motors as arm and finger drivers. And ESP32 is used as an IoT input to send data to the website which later the results of the motor movement at a predetermined angle can be displayed on a cellphone / PC. In conclusion, motor movements in this tool are expected to provide convenience and reduce the risk of disability with the accuracy of motor movements with a standard error value of 0.02%

articleTitle: Implementation Smart Tecnology Based on Industry 40 through the Redesign of the Solar Pond
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Redesign and implement solar paddlewheel using rational methods to improve production efficiency on the use of production equipment in the shrimp pond East Rawajitu, Indonesia. All research data collected is processed using a rational method combined with the Quality Function Deployment method at the Determining Characteristics stage, which will result in the design of a solar pond paddlewheel to reduce operational costs focused on the use of shrimp production aids. The results of the identification of the need for a solar pond paddlewheel using the rational method and Quality Function Deployment found that the priority needs were for a pond paddlewheel not using fuel with a value of 4.67 then, the pond paddlewheel is easy to use with a value of 4.33 and the material for the pond paddlewheel can last for a long time with a value of 4.23 and lastly, the pond paddlewheel is safe to use with a value of 4.13. Based on the results of the redesign of the solar pond paddlewheel which has been tested to be implemented in the Dipasena Earth Shrimp, it provides an increase in operational cost efficiency of 44.66%. The result of the study shows that cost effisiency increases 45%.

articleTitle: The Effect of Visual Merchandising on Impulse Buying in Increasing Sales on Coffee Shops Business
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to find out the effect of visual merchandising and impulse buying to increase sales in the Coffee Shop industry. This research uses a quantitative approach and uses a survey data collection tool in form of Google Forms with the object from Coffee Shop customers. The analysis found that the effect of visual merchandising is positive towards the customers’ impulse buying. Visual merchandising and impulse buying also has a significant effect on increasing sales on coffeeshop business. This study contains a limited discussion of visual merchandising, impulse purchasing, and sales in the coffee shop industry. This research was also conducted in a brief period of time using variables and hypotheses from prior research that were more thoroughly developed. This research is beneficial for Coffee Shop retailers in discovering the positive effects of visual merchandising on businesses’ ability to increase sales by attracting customer interest. This study illustrates the extent to which visual merchandising has a significant impact on Coffee Shop sales by inducing a desire to purchase or curiosity in customers.

articleTitle: Unleashing Responsiveness: A comprehensive approach to improve End-to-End latency for USB-C display for better UX
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly accelerated the demand for multiple displays in the context of remote working and learning. One critical concern in laptop utilizing USB-C displays is their responsiveness. The link training establishes the physical link (4/2/1) and its parameters used for transmission of video and audio over the DP (Display Port) main link. The display driver, responsible for supporting various DP adapters, previously incorporated a static auxiliary retries during clock recovery, which impacted the detection of aux process. Additionally, the internal dependency of the display driver on resetting other enabled displays resulted in prolonged setup time for newly connected displays. Consequently, these factors contributed to increased End-to-End (E2E) latency for Type C displays operating in DP Alternate mode and USB4/Thunderbolt<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup> Tunnel mode. In this paper we present the approach to optimizing the E2E latency for type C display. We also present optimizations pursued and associated learnings for better user experience (UX). We show optimization results which measurably improves responsiveness.

articleTitle: Color Improvement in Underwater Image using Polynomial Equation and Image Dehazing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This paper proposes color restoration techniques in underwater images using polynomial equation techniques and dehazing techniques. Discoloration and light scattering are the two primary factors that produce distortion in underwater images. Loss of contrast and loss of color variation can result from either of these variables in underwater photography. This research contributes to improving the quality of underwater reef images with effective and accurate solutions. A comprehensive verification using MATLAB is carried out to determine the effectiveness of the Polynomial Equation and DeHazing techniques combination. The results of this method get a color quality that is close to the color of the image on the surface. According to the experimental findings, the combined Polynomial Equation and DeHazing technique yields better PSNR results than the other methods used as a benchmark. The PSNR for the Polynomial Equation method is 13.29. The PSNR for the CLAHE method is 12.58. The PSNR for the Dehazing method is 13.72. As well as the combined method of Polynomial Equations - Dehazing get a PSNR value of 14.72. The quality of the image produced by this technique increases with increasing PSNR values. This research expected to be able to get underwater image results that are close to the original color.

articleTitle: Functional Correctness Analysis for Judiciary Office’s Case Administration Application using PHPUnit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Information technology is growing rapidly in the current administration of government to become one of the benchmarks for the realization of e-government. In accordance with presidential instruction number 3 of 2003 and law number 14 of 2008 concerning public information disclosure, the use of information technology is a national priority in government. However, in practice there are still many obstacles regarding software quality testing procedures used in government. The aim of the study was to evaluate the quality of the software for the administrative management information system for the stages of case handling through measurement using functional correctness with an assessment of 1 aspect and 23 methods contained in the application as a testing medium. The research method used is ISO/IEC 25023/2016. The results showed that the application obtained the highest score of 1 which means no errors were found in the code and the lowest was 0.5 with several errors in the code found. From these results obtained recommendations on the Functional Suitability aspect so that it can be used to evaluate software.

articleTitle: Improved Fixed Asset Depreciation Performance on Odoo ERP System with Iterative Linear Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The depreciation of fixed assets makes the data access process become too large for Odoo application and causes problems in data handling. One of the solutions to deal with the problem of asset depreciation process can be done by using a linear search algorithm. In the process of searching for data assets, the performance of the algorithm will be improved by using an iterative linear search algorithm. From the research results it is known that depreciation assets using a search method without iterative has a long process and was even stopped by Odoo. The search method has been improved by using an iterative method in terms of access time and inprocess memory usage aspects. The search method without iteration has a result of 6472.3 MiB. As for the results of Iterative Linear Search Algorithm memory usage, it shows better results with a result of 3881.7 MiB. Meanwhile, in terms of access time, the search method without iteration has a result of 126.3863 s. While the access time required by the iterative linear search algorithm is 0.0215 s. From these results, the iterative linear search algorithm produces faster access times.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network for image based Leaf Type Classification with Feature Extraction GLCM Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: One or more non-green leaf regions are mosaicked together to create variegated leaves. Early interest in the taxonomy of various leaf species was sparked by the various leaf folding patterns. Previous research tried to identify the primary disease kind that affects tomato and grape leaves. Multi-Crop Leaf Disease (MCLD) detection is done using a convolutional neural network (CNN). The created model more accurately categorizes sick leaves. In the hypothetical trial, the study's accuracy was 95.71% for tomatoes and 98.40% for grapes. The Artificial Neural Network (ANN) classification approach is suggested for this study because of the abundance of studies that have been conducted on various leaf types. This study used 5-step iteration optimization to calculate the number of folds utilizing loops from a minimum of 2 to a maximum of 10, and 21 characteristics were used. The dataset consisted of 275 different types of leaves. In this study, the accuracy was 92.8% at 4751 iterations, the number of folds at the eighth iteration, 100 neural training cycles, a 0.5 neural learning rate, and 0.6 momentum, and the RMSE was 0.264 with a standard deviation (+/-) of 5.73%.

articleTitle: Benefit Realization Measurement: Do Electronic Medical Records Improve the Effectiveness of Data Management?
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: RSI Jemursari has implemented the electronic medical records system since 2016 to solve problems related to the management of medical record data. To determine the achievement of the objectives of implementing the system, it is necessary to measure the benefits realization. The method used to measure the benefits is the benefits realization management. The research stages include developing benefit result chain, developing benefits register, and benefit measurement. The results of this study indicate that all the benefits expected from the implementation of the electronic medical records system have been realized. The use of racks as many as 27 units was replaced with 1 server. 93% of medical record officers and 60% of registration officers agree that this system reduces paper usage and reduces file accumulation. Paper procurement costs of 150 million and storage space of 1 billion 410 million no longer need to be spent after electronic medical records are used. In terms of data, retrieval becomes faster. The previous search time of 5-15 minutes became 3.36 minutes. As many as 80% of respondents from medical record officers agree that this system make it easier to access. Overall, an increase in the effectiveness of data management was achieved.

articleTitle: Efficiency Assessment of Mobile Game-based Learning based on Fingerstroke Level Model (FLM)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The development of digital games, including digital game-based learning (DGBL), has rapidly grown over the past decade. DGBL is an alternative learning model that aims to increase student motivation and analyze the learning process. However, subjective assessments are commonly used to evaluate the effectiveness of DGBL, which has limitations, particularly in measuring player motivation in real-time during gameplay. Objective assessment approaches, such as the Fingerstroke Level Model (FLM), which quantitatively measures the speed of a user in completing a task based on the interface design, are necessary to evaluate usability features. The FLM has been implemented in educational games on mobile touch input devices and provides objective feedback for users and game-based learning developers. This research focuses on the efficiency of digital game-based learning that has been developed, whether it meets the standards of stakeholders and game developers. The results of the study show that there are several operators that are not applied by the user ideally, but with the leveling of these operators the efficiency increases because of the learning process at each level.

articleTitle: Optimization of a High Order Polynomial with the White Balancing method for underwater image improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This paper proposes the use of the white balance method in image preprocessing before applying the high-order polynomial (HOP) method for image improvement. The main contribution in this process is preparing the image to overcome unequal color absorption caused by differences in distance when the image is taken. In the calculations on the HOP method, the preparation of mathematical calculations is carried out assuming the same distance between the object and the camera; closer or farther distances will cause different light absorption in image capture; this needs to be done to balance the color tone of the image. To test the effectiveness of the proposed method, a simulation is carried out using MATLAB 2022 by preprocessing the images taken by carrying out the white balance process by adjusting the brightness of the light in the image, the results of this image are the basis for applying the HOP process to obtain images with color correction that are closer to the original color. The superiority of the proposed method is confirmed by calculating the Mean Square Error (MSE) and Peak Signal Noise Ratio (PSNR) where the PSNR value obtained is 19.80 dB, 0.52 points higher than just using HOP. This modeling will be useful in the maritime field in observing the development of coral reefs through color information on coral reefs, which is also used as an indicator of world environmental health.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness of Autoregression to Predict Temperature
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Slight changes in the climate affect people and many aspects of their life. People living in countries around the world, in particular those residing in the underdeveloped countries, begin to feel the effects of climate change. The rapid advancement of statistical method allows the use of certain methods to be used for future prediction. One of the methods is autoregression, a time series type of date, which could effectively be used to predict the weather. Our study is on the effectiveness of autoregression in predicting future temperature. Autoregression is effective at predicting time series data because of the way it looks at past data and trends. When the data is consistent, it will have a high accuracy of prediction. The dataset that was used contained one kind of data, the temperature. Looking at the past data, the trend of the temperature of the areas can be determined. The algorithm took 950 data as a sample data set. Before 285 data were employed for a data test, 655 data were utilized to train the model; the model predicted 285 days. The use of these data was based on the reason that they do not need a large computing power to run the model. The 655 data for training and 285 data for testing the 1/4 data division is enough to create a conclusive model that could predict efficiently. The finding is that autoregression is quite accurate at predicting the temperature with a Mean Absolute Error of 1.4, which means that the model is off by at least 1.4 degree Celcius. In short, autoregression as an algorithm which is used to predict the future by looking at past data is a good way to easily determine the future.

articleTitle: Rainfall Prediction using Neural Network Model with Autocorrelation Function and Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Weather conditions are one of the vital factors that influence aircraft takeoff activities at airports. This is because weather conditions can affect the lift force of an aircraft. The weather conditions in Indonesia, as a country located in a tropical region with a vast ocean area and surrounded by two continents, make it difficult to accurately predict the weather due to its highly dynamic nature. This research proposes the utilization of pre-processing methods, specifically ACF and correlation analysis, on past weather observation data as input to predict rainfall for the next day in the vicinity of Ahmad Yani Semarang Airport. This method is crucial for analyzing time-series data. ANN with backpropagation based model is used in this study to predict rainfall. Using the same model configuration, we compared the output result from the dataset before applying ACF and correlation analysis and after applying it. It was found that by applying ACF and correlation analysis to our dataset, we managed to achieve a better prediction of rainfall by reducing the RMSE and MAE values. We had initial RMSE and MAE values of 14.8 and 12.6, respectively, before employing ACF and correlation analysis on our dataset. However, by implementing these techniques, we were able to decrease the RMSE to 7.1 and the MAE to 6.5.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Model for Breast Cancer Classification with K-Means Clustering Feature Selection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the major causes of fatalities in women across the globe, necessitating early diagnosis and detection for successful treatment. Scientists have pinpointed numerous risk factors for breast cancer such as obesity and sex hormones. Machine learning prediction systems have employed diverse data types, like genetic profiles, clinical data, and X-ray images, to foresee the risk of breast cancer. To eliminate any unnecessary or superfluous attributes from high-dimensional datasets, algorithms for feature selection have been applied. This research proposes a composite machine learning model integrating five models: Gradient Boosting (GB), Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression with Lasso Regularization, Logistic Regression with Ridge Regression, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Feature selection methodologies employed are based on the K-Means clustering oriented feature importance measure. The Coimbra breast cancer dataset, composed of 116 data points and 10 characteristics, is used for training and assessing the models on their predictive abilities. According to the study’s outcomes, the Support Vector Machine model demonstrates the greatest effectiveness for the dataset when used with the proposed feature selection, whereas Gradient Boosting and Random Forest are efficacious models without feature selection.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Asphalt Road Quality Classification Based on CNN Architecture VGG16
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Damaged road conditions often cause accidents, even resulting in casualties and loss of property as a result of being mired or struck or hit by another vehicle while avoiding the damaged road. Therefore, it is necessary to survey the condition of asphalt roads for the transportation agency, not only to ensure road safety but also to properly implement road maintenance and rehabilitation. In this study, the authors conducted research to classify the good and bad quality of asphalt highways using the convolution neural network method with the VGG16 architecture. In this study, two tests were carried out, namely the first test with 224x224 images and the second test with 64x64 images. The results of this test obtain a good accuracy value for the 224x224 image, which is 92.47%. In an image measuring 64x64 the accuracy level beats in research [12] which is only 87.80%.

articleTitle: Enterprise Architecture Trends in the Digital Transformation Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Enterprise Architecture (EA) is a solution to build alignment between business strategy and information technology in dealing with digital transformation that causes fundamental changes for companies and businesses. The purpose of this study is to examine the trends and progress of EA in responding to the challenges of the digital transformation era, which is carried out through SLRs using the PRISMA method. According to the research findings, implementing EA in businesses serves the following purposes: establishing clear objectives and strategies for the development of business and technology, achieving harmony between business and information technology, time and cost efficiency, and effectiveness in business development processes and information technology. Then, it was concluded that there are nine components of EA, namely, vision, mission, and strategic objectives; business architecture; data & information architecture; information system architecture; infrastructure and network architecture; security architecture; human resources architecture; governance, legal, and compliance; and standards & regulations.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Flow Information System and Community Behaviour in Waste Management based on Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The increasing amount of waste in the city of Semarang needs proper handling. These problems will be solved using an information system approach to handling and managing waste. The purpose of this research is to map community behavior regarding the handling and management of organic and inorganic waste; determine the supply chain flow of waste handling in the community, hotels, restaurants and offices; designing an industry-based waste management information system 4.0. This research has been able to map community behavior regarding the handling and management of organic and inorganic waste in the form of supply chain flows from upstream to downstream. The data processing stage begins with statistical testing of the result of the questionnaire, then designing the waste supply chain flow. The results of the supply chain flow for handling waste in the community, hotels, restaurants and offices are designed by utilizing an industry-based waste management information system 4.0. The supply chain designed in 6 areas of the city of Semarang, has been able to describe the flow of waste from upstream to downstream.

articleTitle: Quality Detection of Sweet Potato Leaves Using YOLOv4-Tiny
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In Southeast Asia, people use sweet potato leaves as a type of vegetable for cooking, and they are also used as animal feed. Sweet potato leaves are commonly used in traditional medicine to treat tumors in the mouth and throat. There are different types of sweet potato leaves, including antin sweet potato leaves, papua salosa sweet potato leaves, sweet potato leaves, and Cilembu sweet potato leaves. The method used in this study is to detect the quality of sweet potato leaves, namely by going through the dataset process, bounding box, then the training process and finally the evaluation using the Mean Average Precision (mAP). The results of the quality detection test for sweet potato leaves using YOLOv4-Tiny can be concluded that the maximum results according to the grade of each sweet potato leaf starting from the antin yam leaves have an MAP result of 0.79 on grade_a. Furthermore, sweet potato leaves with grade_b have an MAP value of 0.67. The papua salosa type of sweet potato leaves grade_a has a value of 0.70. The process of testing sweet potato leaves on grade_a has an MAP result of 0.82 on grade_b. The last test of Cilembu sweet potato leaves has a mean average precision (mAP) value at grade_a, which has a value of 0.75, and for grade_b. It has a mean average precision result of 0.40. As a result, it can be inferred that the utilization of YOLOv4-Tiny for identifying the quality of sweet potato leaves has been effective.

articleTitle: Study of Current and Voltage Stability as a Result of Inertia Settings in Wind Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Wind energy potential exists almost everywhere in the globe and may be used to generate electricity. A means of transforming wind energy into electrical energy that customers may utilise is a wind power plant. The output characteristics of the wind power plant must be stable for the electrical energy to be appropriate for usage in electrical loads. Stable output current and voltage are these variables. Sometimes the output current and voltage become unsteady due to the fluctuating wind speed and dynamic load operation. In order to maintain stable current and voltage, the inertia of the wind power plant must be controlled. The wind power plant's inertia values of 0.1, 1, 2.5, 4 and 5 are used in the study methodology. The loads related to the wind power plant are included in the dynamic loads during the wind power plant's inertia test. The stability of current and voltage is affected differently by each magnitude of inertia. Compared to other inertia values, the value of 5 offers the highest current and voltage stability. The output current and voltage of the wind power plant are more steady the greater the magnitude of inertia. The stability curve's wave fluctuations are also smaller and shorter for an inertia value of 5.

articleTitle: Developing the Connection of Batik Lasem's E-Commerce Platform and Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Since the Covid 19 pandemic, Batik Lasem's sales have been taking a plunge since they rely heavily on tourists. Combined with the new highway cutting through Lasem, the sales of Batik Lasem has never been lower. Competing against bigger and more established Batik corporate in online sales is not easy, therefore Batik Lasem needs a new method of showcasing and selling Batik virtually through metaverse. Objective of this research is to develop a direct connection system between metaverse scene and e-commerce website. The connection is achieved using Woocommerce as the e-commerce site with payment gateway plugin and 2D objects inside the metaverse scene as a vessel to attach the product URL. The research found that the connection between metaverse and e-commerce site is feasible but not very optimal on some devices. User experience on VR head mount is not optimal for doing transaction but PC and mobile devices do not give the most immersive ambience for users.

articleTitle: Foggy-Based Object Detection In Video Using Faster R-CNN, YOLOv3, and SSD
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This paper discusses a comparison of several methods used for object detection in bad weather conditions, such as the presence of fog that interferes with the object's view. The methods compared in this paper include Faster R-CNN, Yolov3, and SSD (Single Shot Multi-Box Detector). This work contributes to evaluating the best method to overcome the object detection problem in bad weather, which is measured by mean average precision (mAP). The evaluation is executed using video objects that are converted into frames. Based on experimental results, the Faster R-CNN method is superior in terms of the mAP value where the Faster R-CNN is 87%, using SSD is 48%, and Yolov3 is 31%. Faster R-CNN provides better performance than the other two methods because the basic idea of FRCNN is the use of a Region Proposal Network (RPN) in a feature map which aims to propose many objects that can be identified in a particular image.

articleTitle: Rainfall Estimation In Equatorial Region Using Weather Radar-Based Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The equatorial region has high rainfall because it is located near the equator, where the sun produces very high energy throughout the year. This impacts biological habitats, the global water cycle, and people's everyday life. Accurate rainfall information is important for disaster mitigation, air resources management, and climate modeling. This study calculated estimated rainfall in an area with an equatorial rain pattern in Pontianak, Indonesia. The method applied is a comparison using four machine learning algorithms: Decision Tree, Random Forest, Adaptive Boosting, and Gradient Boosting. This comparison aims to get the estimated value of rainfall. The Decision Tree algorithm produces an accuracy value of RMSE of 0.693 and an R2 correlation of 0.449; Random Forest produces an RMSE of 0.642 and an R2 of 0.527; Adaptive Boosting produces an RMSE of 0.725 and R2 of 0.395, and Gradient Boosting produces RMSE of 0.561 and R2 of 0.638. It was concluded that the Gradient Boosting algorithm could provide the best rainfall estimation in Pontianak, West Kalimantan, Indonesia.

articleTitle: Tune Up Multi Layer Perceptron From Sentiment Analysis with Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is frequently worn for opinion mining of giving data or corpora a name or label (high quality, bad, impartial) into information or corpus. It is possible to say that NLP (Natural Language Processing) is used for preprocess data and clean text so it can be comprehended by machines. Text classification is worn to handle data and corpora that are entered into the multi-layer perceptron model of the classification engine, which will then result in a projection of exactness percentage > 90%. (better). A supervised learning process is the figure of the data used to convey the output of the machine learning model. The accuracy of the machine model that was drill is improved by the use of model selection, which employs the Monte Carlo cross-validation model. The accuracy of the drilled machine model is improved by using model selection, which employs the Monte Carlo cross-validation model. The experiment's effects on the gadget constructed received an evaluation of up to 95.29%

articleTitle: Preliminary Results from Spatial Characterization of Tropical Rain Using Weather Radar Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Rain attenuation is one of the main problems in wireless communications above 10 GHz in tropical areas, including radio access networks that involve multiple links with coordinated multipoint (CoMP) transmission. To evaluate the impact of rain attenuation on millimeter-wave transmission, spatial characterization of rainfall rate is carried out using weather radar data in the form of CAPPI. Radar data processing is able to produce an autocorrelation function of rainfall in the area covered by the rain event. This information can be used in spatial generation of rain attenuation in simulations to evaluate performance of mm-wave CoMP transmission. Results of processing tropical rain radar data show that by focusing on an area in the same order of the area occupied by a rain event, small details including multiple peaks of rain rate can be observed within a single rain event. With a smaller area of observation covering the middle part of the rain event area, the spatial correlation of rainfall rate decreases more steeply with the distance compared to the case of a wider area. Furthermore, observation focused on a 3 km × 3 km area is more appropriate for evaluating the impact of tropical rain in a mm-wave radio access network where the maximum length of access links is typically 200-500 m.

articleTitle: Optimization of Lighting Plan Based on Light Intensity and Magnetic Field Exposure for Residential Houses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Lighting is an important element in the life of modern society. Lighting is a technology that is well known in the community, houses and lights complement each other, but in practice the use of lights that are currently used in housing are generally installed with very little following the rules or standardizing the application of lights in the house. So that the negative impact of neglect is inefficient power consumption and exacerbated by inappropriate usage patterns. This research was carried out by observing the shape of the space in the dwelling, measuring the light intensity from the lamps, and measuring magnetic exposure based on the types of lamps commonly used in residential areas. The result of this research is an optimization for Lighting Plan that can be done based on the needs and lighting standard references.

articleTitle: Enhancing Performance of Citizen-Based Dynamic Criteria for Government Group Decision Making Using Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Government group decision-making often encounters problems. Because decision makers have dynamic criteria. The best government decisions are citizen-based decisions. This study has a focus on improving the performance of citizen-based dynamic criteria. The criteria can be used for government group decision making. This study uses the K-Means method and the K-Medoids method for clustering analysis. The K-Means Method and the K-Medoids Method can label citizen-based data. Because there are no labels from residents in the survey data. Criteria data must have a label beforehand to help decision making. This study also aims to compare the accuracy and error of the clustering method. Based on the research results, the accuracy of the K-Means method and the K-Medoids method are 79.5% and 79%. The errors of the K-Means method and the K-Medoids method are 20.5% and 21%. The K-Means method has better accuracy and error than the K-Medoids method. This research is expected to support democratic governance. Because citizen based dynamic criteria can be useful for group government decision making.

articleTitle: Development of Voice Chatbot for E-Concierge System of Front Office Hotel
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The rapid advancement of technology has simplified the process of accessing hotel information, but many hotel websites still lack robust customer support. Chatbots present a solution to reduce the workload of concierge staff. Our study aims to design a chatbot using Android Studio, Flutter, Dialogflow, and Firebase. This chatbot facilitates reservations, supports user interaction via menu-driven options, and delivers comprehensive hotel information. The Binus Hotel's chatbots have been fully integrated with Google Assistant, enabling guests to engage with them through Google Home and smartphones as a Voicebot. The Binus Hotel Chatbot not only alleviates the burden on concierge staff but also provides guests with in-depth hotel information. In conclusion, the Binus Hotel Chatbot emerges as an innovative communication medium for guests, streamlining the reservation process by offering timely and pertinent details.

articleTitle: Scabies Skin Classification Using SVM Method With GLCM Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The skin is the first organ in the human body, pain and other factors. Lack of knowledge about the types of scabies and not knowing how to prevent it can cause a person to get this skin disease. To perform image analysis based on the statistical distribution of the pixel intensity, it can be done by extracting features. In the feature extraction process using Contrast, Correlation, Energy, Homogeneity is good in determining the value of skin texture or defects while in the results of segmentation and feature extraction based on shape and texture characteristics, feature extraction based on skin texture can be a variable in classifying skin images. The increase in accuracy value in the processing of skin image classification of artificial neural networks has a less high accuracy value compared to the Support Vector Machine method based on class or skin labels. At an angle of 0° precision gets 91%, recall 90%, and accuracy 95%. For an angle of 45° precision 96%, recall 96% accuracy 95%. At the GLCM angle to 90° precision 92%, recall 92% and accuracy 93%. Angle 135° precision 87% Recall 86% and Accuracy 91%, it can be concluded that in ANN the best accuracy is obtained at a GLCM angle of 45° with an accuracy of 98%. As for the results of the support vector machine at an angle of 0° the precision gets 98%, 98% recall, and 99% accuracy. For an angle of 45° precision 98%, recall 98% accuracy 99%. At the GLCM angle to 90° precision 96%, recall 96% and accuracy 98%. Angle 135° precision 98%, Recall 98% and Accuracy 99%. The highest accuracy is obtained at GLCM angles of 0°, 45°, 135° Support Vector Machine obtains the highest accuracy with an accuracy of 99%.

articleTitle: Are the Citizens of Semarang ready for The Citizen Health App (SatuSehat Mobile)? A Prediction Model from Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The covid-19 has been forcing the speed of digital transformation in human life, including the health sector. The government of Indonesia developed Peduli Lindungi Apps, an application to control Covid-19. Peduli Lindungi transforms to Citizen Health Apps (Satu Sehat Mobile) after the Pandemic. In developing countries, most health information technologies (HIT) are often total or partial failures or are unsustainable. This study describes the factors related to the usability of Peduli Lindungi Application and predicts the use of Citizen Health Apps (Satu Sehat Mobile) through the decision tree model. The data was collected from March-June 2022 using a questionnaire. This study distributed a questionnaire to 300 patients from three Public hospitals in Semarang City, Central Java, Indonesia. The questionnaire consists of some measurements comprised of the health literacy index (HLS-EU-SQ10-IDN), Digital Health Literacy Competencies for Citizen (DHLC) , and usability. This study developed a model to predict the usability of citizen health app (former Peduli Lindungi Apps) and resulted in 64.7% accuracy of performance classification. The model of this study describes that sequence factors to affect the usability of Citizen health Apps are health literacy level, digital health literacy, education, and gender. The model shows that health literacy level is the first factor related usability Peduli Lindungi, after downloading the application. Respondents with problematics health literacy should have DHLC in the level expert and the higher education to have high usability while respondents with Non-Health Higher education should have independent and expert Digital Health Literacy to have high usability.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Students’ Non-Fluency in Speaking English: A Case in Bina Nusantara University
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study aimed to see phenomena of students’ English non-fluency, its possible cause and later provide insight for educator or in developing English speaking fluency of the students from various background. 116 Students were observed through their speaking task analysis and it was found that 76% of the students produce mispronounced pronunciation on and 94% of the students did grammatical errors during their speaking test. Later, e-questionnaire were delivered to 127 students in which they were asked several question that delve possible factors influencing their influency such as Linguistic factors, Psycholinguistic factors, Age, Sociolinguistic factors, Bilingualism, Individual difference or attitude, Developmental factors, and Frequency of input. It is found that they are predominantly from Javanese and Chinese descent. 84 of them starts learning English when they are around Elementary school. 57 of them speak English in both focused and unfocused context, and 41 of them master 3 languages which are earned on different developmental factors. 39 of them have never taken any English course al all, 85 of them has never lived abroad and 60 of them mentioned that they are just sometimes being in an English speaking environment. These all indicates low frequency of input and exposure of English.

articleTitle: Time-Scale Modification Phase Vocoder for Accent Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: English is an international language for most countries in this world use to communicate. Although there are only common English versions, namely UK and US, there are differences in pronunciation due to the influence of the first language. An accent is a special trait in human communication, which cannot be obtained through education but is obtained when someone lives in a unique and cultured area for a long time. Accent recognition is used in both forensic applications and Automatic Speech Recognition Systems (ASR) but accent variations are required for speaker recognition or speech recognition, therefore accent recognition research still has many challenges. In this research, phase vocoder is used as a time-scale modification method used to equate all audio data to the same length duration to the average duration of each first language. This research and related researches that use the same dataset employ imbalanced data for analysis. Then after augmentation of audio data, spectral-based features are used and Linear SVM as a classifier with hyperparameter regularization.
