From the experiment has been done performance classification the lowest is 45% and the highest is 84.1%.

articleTitle: Local Error Translation and Translation Technique Analyses from Instagram Account "Info Kejadian Semarang" using Instagram Translation Machine and Google Lens Translation Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This aim of this research is to see the difference of the translation through machine translation from Instagram and Google Lens, which one made more error and which one is more creative on using translation technique to using vocabulary to transfer the message. The source data was taken from Info Kejadian Semarang Instagram account, with the research data is Local error translation and using descriptive qualitative method and random sampling which is the researcher randomly choose a picture in Info Kejadian Semarang Instagram account. The way the researcher to collect the data is (1) the researcher switch the language setting on researcher’s Instagram account from Indonesian to English, (2) the researcher open Info Kejadian Semarang account and then choose captions from the photos who the researcher want to research, and then click the option of "see translation" under the caption and do the screenshots from the Indonesian caption and English caption and the result of the screenshots will automatically save on phone and save the photos on save feature on Instagram. And then the researcher sent the screenshots of Indonesian caption to Google Lens to translate to English and do the screenshoots to be the data. The amount of the Local Error from Instagram Machine Translation is 7 errors categories from 9 categories, while Google Lens Machine Translation is 6 errors categories from 9 errors categories. And the amount of the translation technique the mostly use on the both of the machine translations is Establish Equivalent which is this technique can adjust the meaning of the text according to the grammar rules on the target language (TL). The percentage of the Establish Equivalent technique on Instagram Machine Translation is 52%, while from Google Lens Machine Translation is 60%. From the amount above based on the local error translation can be seen that Instagram Machine Translation have more error than Google Lens Machine Translation, the meaning is Google Lens more helpful the society to translating target text (TT) adjust to the source text (ST). From the amount above based on Translating Techniques can be seen that Google Lens Machine Translation is more creative to transfer the meaning of the text according to the grammar rules on the target language (TL) than Instagram Machine Translation.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of the Effectiveness of OpenAI's ChatGPT for Automated Python Program Bug Fixing using QuixBugs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In recent years, the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become increasingly common in various fields, including in software development. One such field is where AI can automatically detect and fix bugs in code. GPT-3.5 is a state-of-the-art language model developed by OpenAI that has been trained on a massive amount of text data to generate natural language responses to a wide range of prompts. One of the main challenges in software development is bug fixing, which can be a time-consuming and complicated process. QuixBugs is a framework for evaluating automatic program repair techniques, which can be used to test the effectiveness of GPT-3.5 and similar bug-fixing tools. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of GPT-3.5 in automatically fixing bugs in Python code using QuixBugs. Through testing with 40 different Python bugs, We discovered that GPT-3.5 was able to accurately fix 30 out of 40 bugs cases from QuixBugs benchmark. Compared with other tools like standard program repair and Codex, ChatGPT outperformed them significantly. These findings highlight the potential of ChatGPT as a powerful tool for enhancing code quality and reducing the burden of manual bug fixing.

articleTitle: Deep Learning as a Solution for Egg Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The society is aware of the essential nutrients present in eggs, such as protein, vitamins, and minerals. The eggshell can indicate and be utilized to detect and assess egg quality. Dirty eggs pose a significant risk to consumers as they can harbor harmful Salmonella bacteria, leading to adverse health consequences. Automating the process of selecting and classifying clean and dirty eggs is an alternative solution that is more efficient, as manual labor is time-consuming, complex, and monotonous. Therefore, it is necessary to develop an automated egg classification system. This research aims to develop a classification process for dirty and clean eggs. The methodology employs GLCM-Deep Learning to automatically identify dirty and clean eggs. Three optimizers are used: Adam optimizer, rmsprop optimizer, and sgd optimizer, with the RELU activation function. The dataset consists of a total of 1000 images of dirty eggs and 1000 clean eggs, with 400 samples in the test dataset. The best result from the GLCM-Deep Learning model was achieved using the rmsprop optimizer with an accuracy of 62.5%. This research is of great importance as it addresses the complexity and inefficiency in egg classification and selection processes, and enables automatic determination and evaluation of egg quality.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review of Data Distribution in Preprocessing Stage with Focus on Outliers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Data Preprocessing refers to the steps and techniques applied to raw data before it is ready to be analyzed or modeled as a substantive part of the data flow and aims to transform, clean and organize data in a revised way for the quality, relevance and efficiency of subsequent data analysis tasks. Handling outliers in the N2O Emissions Dataset, Fertilizer Prediction and Crop Yield Prediction Dataset is an important step in the data analysis process. The approach taken will depend on the specific context and purpose of the analysis, and it is important to carefully consider the impact of outliers on the results. Using the methods discussed researchers and analysts can effectively identify and treat outliers in the N2O Emissions Dataset, Fertilizer Prediction, Crop Yield Prediction Dataset, and produce more accurate and reliable results. Implemented a systematic literature that involved searching for articles published from 2015 to 2023 for review. The quality of the existing studies used the assessment criteria of 50 relevant studies identified as having been conducted following systematic literature guidelines.

articleTitle: The Effect of Information Quality and Interaction Quality on Interpersonal Relationships and Their Impact on Purchase Intention in Live Shopping Feature
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In the current era of development of the online shopping model, the live shopping feature is also overgrowing. This study examines the effect of information quality and information quality on interpersonal relationships and purchase intentions among users of the live shopping feature in e-commerce and social commerce in the Greater Jakarta area. The survey was distributed online using purposive sampling, a sample of 211 respondents who had accessed the live shopping feature. This study was analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and tested empirically using Partial Least Square (PLS). And the analysis results show that information quality and interaction quality have a role in building interpersonal relationships that affect customer purchase intentions in live shopping features in e-commerce and social commerce. This study will be useful for e-commerce and social commerce industries to develop and design e-service quality in live shopping features that effectively influence customer purchase intentions.

articleTitle: ‘Do Not Disturb’: An Implication Design To Be Alerted But Less Stress
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The pervasive utilization of smartphones, while augmenting personal and professional communications, also elicits mental stress and disrupts the work-life balance. Users necessitate staying connected to critical updates without undue disruption, necessitating an optimized, user-friendly smartphone interface. However, current "Do Not Disturb (DND)" features fall short of providing the desired customization options, thereby contributing to heightened anxiety and diminished productivity. Consequently, this study proposes a design modification to the DND mode by incorporating an "Exceptional Apps Notification", feature thereby aiding in alleviating stress and enhancing focus by permitting essential alerts from selected apps or contacts. In other words, the users only need to turn off notifications for specific applications, not every application. This approach addresses the problem of users fearing they will miss some important notifications. Therefore, the design process employed principles of selective attention and color theory, and user experience was assessed through questionnaires and psycho-physiological feedback. Early findings suggest the potential for stress reduction, albeit with opportunities for further optimization, such as including a memory feature for user preferences and allowing selective access for specific contacts.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Poem Genre Classification using a Combination of SMOTE and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Text classification aims to be able to classify documents into the correct class. In this study, the use of SVM to perform text classification. The existence of this research is to find out how good the performance produced by SVM is in classifying text. A total of 841 poetry data were categorized into 4 genres namely affection, death, environment, and music. The data is cleaned at the text preprocessing stage with the stages of case folding (lowercase, remove punctuation and whitespace), tokenization, stopword removal, and lemmatizing. Feature extraction using Bag of Word (BoW) produces 6860 features. Features resulting from BoW will be weighted using TF - IDF. Data separation is carried out with a separation ratio of 80:20, 70:30, and 60:40. There is data imbalance, so it needs to be balanced. In this research, data balancing is done using SMOTE. Data separation is done for original data, balancing result data, and balancing result data with PCA. The highest accuracy result of train data is obtained by balancing data with a 60:40 separation of 97%. While the highest test data accuracy result is obtained by balancing data with an 80:20 separation of 87%. Thus the highest accuracy of each train data and test data is obtained by balancing data.

articleTitle: Javanese Script Single Letters Classification using GoogLeNet Architecture and Adam Optimizer Based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study examines the decline in the usage of the Javanese language, which has experienced a decrease in the number of speakers from approximately 82 million in 2007 to 68.2 million in 2015. The convergence of the Javanese script and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology is proposed as a solution, allowing for the preservation and accessibility of the Javanese script in the digital age. The integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in Javanese script classification achieved a high accuracy rate of 92.95% in identifying positive and negative cases. The dataset used for training consisted of 8440 sample images, which were divided into 20 subfolders for training and testing. The results presented in Table IV demonstrate the successful implementation of the classification model, achieving a 98.87% sensitivity, 100% precision, and 98.88% specificity. This research contributes to the preservation and understanding of the culturally significant Javanese script while addressing the decline in its usage.

articleTitle: Disturbing Bit-transition Using History-based Mechanism against Power Analysis Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: With the proliferation of IoT edge devices in recent years, there is a growing demand for lightweight tamper-resistant designs. This paper proposes History-based Wave Flip-Flop (HW-FF), a history-based bit-transition disturbing mechanism that improves upon the previous research of Wave Flip-Flop (W-FF) and achieves tamper-resistance comparable to Wave Dynamic Differential Logic (WDDL), which requires significant circuit modifications and additions. In our evaluation, it was confirmed that HW-FF maintains a mere 2% increase in area compared to W-FF in ASIC implementation.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Diabetes Diagnosis Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic condition characterized by increasing blood sugar levels above average. In the long term, diabetes can have damaging effects on the kidneys, heart, nerves, eyes, and other complications. Early detection in the treatment of diabetes can prevent and reduce the risk of further disease complications. The field of diabetes prediction is experiencing significant growth in research endeavors. Early diabetes prediction will lead to improved treatment. In this study, we propose predicting the diagnosis of diabetes using machine learning algorithms. The dataset utilized in this research is the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset (PIDD), sourced from the UCI machine learning repository. Seven machine learning classification algorithms are applied: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Gradient Boosting. Various measures, including Accuracy, Precision, F-Measure, Recall, and Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC), evaluate the performance of the seven machine learning algorithms. The performance results show that the KNN algorithm obtains the highest accuracy of 80.51% and Precision of 78%. The Random Forest algorithm gets the highest score on the Recall at 75%, F-Measure at 72%, and ROC at 78.18%.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Impulse Buying Behavior on Live Streaming E-Commerce Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Live streaming in e-commerce continues to grow, a new business model that allows e-commerce to directly interact with consumers. The interactions that occur can have an impact on impulse buying behavior through various related external factors. This study aims to determine external factors in live streaming by comprehensively exploring the influence of external stimuli and internal mechanisms on consumer impulse buying behavior. The sample in this study was 370 respondents, with the criteria of having made purchases of live streaming e-commerce transactions such as Shopee, Tokopedia, and Lazada. This research is an associative descriptive study using PLS-SEM analysis. The results of the study show that the variables anchor characteristics, online comments, logistics service quality, promotional incentive information, promotion time limit have a positive effect on impulsive buying behavior through the mediation of perceived trust and perceived value. Logistics Service Quality has the most significant effect on perceived trust and value. Improving the quality of logistics services such as handling returns or replacement of goods more quickly will be able to encourage user trust and satisfaction in making transactions through live streaming services.

articleTitle: Security and Supporting Factors To Predict The Rapid Adoption of M-Payments in Rural Areas of Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Because of its practical nature, m-payment is an alternative representative technique that individuals often use for transactions. However, users in rural areas are concerned about the security of the m-payment system. Therefore, this research seeks to identify the elements that drive the intention to use m-payment and the facets that contribute to the security of the m-payment system. Data collection used an online questionnaire, and 270 data were collected. Data were interpreted operating multivariate statistics using partial least square-structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) technique. This investigation proves that perceived ease of use (PEOU), relative advantage, security, and visibility positively and significantly affect the intention to use m-payments in rural communities. Furthermore, privacy has a negative and significant effect on security. Trialability and ubiquity have a positive and significant impact on security. Practically, this research contributes to m-payment service providers in understanding how users in rural areas adopt m-payment.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Data Sharing Model for Assessment of Lubangsewu Erorejo Tourism Destinations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: In 2023, the population of Erorejo, Indonesia, will be 981 people, of which 105 heads of families work as red tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) freshwater fishermen and tour operators in Lubangsewu. After the COVID-19 pandemic, regional problems emerged, namely, the marketing of freshwater fish decreased by 30-35%, and the number of visitors to Lubangsewu decreased by around 40%. To increase the number of visitors, we developed an initial evaluation model for the Lubangsewu tourist destination, which is easily accessible to all users with guaranteed data security. This research aims to create a decentralized data-sharing model in a blockchain-based distributed network to evaluate the Lubangsewu tourist destination. We used the Hyperledger fabric platform using ten nodes; Then, we tested the blockchain process and proof of work performed to determine that the data-sharing process was successful and that the hash value obtained from the data identification could meet the set targets. The results showed that testing the chaining block process on localhost-based data-sharing assessments and peer-to-peer devices succeeded in forming interconnected chaining blocks. The target in this study is the prefix hash value digit 0. When trying to prove work done on a localhost basis, the seven hash values met the proof of work target, and the average time taken was 67.9 m/s. Meanwhile, eight hash values were obtained in the peer-to-peer device performance proof test, which met the proof of work target with an average longer time of 321.4 m/s so that this model can increase the number of visitors.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Investment Education from Twitter using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: People’s perspectives can be found on various platforms, including Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, and Youtube, as a result of the recent rise of social media as a significant means of education and communication. This research makes use of a dataset obtained from Twitter that contains 700 posts discussing various aspects of investment education. Natural language processing tasks, including text analysis, have benefited greatly from machine learning and deep learning approaches due to their adaptability, effectiveness, and promise. We adapted the knowledge of native and linguistic experts in Indonesian language to manually confirmed whether a tweet is Positive or Negative. Manual annotation and text/emotion analysis have both seen extensive application of machine learning techniques. One model of learning model SVM as base learner has also demonstrated great classification accuracy, and its different kernels have been utilized for sentiment categorization. To effectively create and test the learner, we used fastText and Multilingual Sentence BERT, the two methods of feature extraction. All of the SVM learners with different kinds of kernels have been tested in terms of key performance indicators such as Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-score. In our experiment, SVM with Polynomial kernel acquired the greatest accuracy of 98.1%.

articleTitle: The Effects of Mathematics Game-based Learning with Random Maze Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Mathematics is one of the difficult subjects that many students can agree on, especially in higher education. The key to teaching mathematics is repetition. Students' skills can be nurtured by practicing repetitively. This concept of repetition can be integrated with the video game framework. This study proposes game-based mathematics teaching with procedural content generation. This study involved an experimental group and a control group. The experimental group was tutored with game-based learning. The tutoring involved a self-made game designed with random maze generation. The maze was fitted with mathematic problems to be solved by the player as part of its design. This design presented an interactive mathematics exercise for its players. On the other hand, the control group will be tutored traditionally. Both groups were given a pre-test and a post-test. The result provided data for analysis. The analysis will use the non-parametric tests "Mann-Whitney U Test" and "Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test." The experimental group was also given questionnaires to be filled out at the beginning and the end of the experiment. The questionnaire results represented how the proposed game design was received by the experimental group. The results of this study show positive results. Game-based tutoring produces a slightly better result than the traditional method. The participants in the experimental group had positive opinions on the game design, content, and fun aspect but not for its difficulty and impact on study interest.

articleTitle: Rice Variety Identification Using Edge Feature Extraction and Texture-Based Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This research proposes a methodology for identifying the optimal feature combination using Support Vector Machine (SVM) based on edge and texture features. Canny, Sobel, and Prewitt for edge detection and GLCM, Gabor, and LBP for texture analysis are popular feature extraction techniques widely employed in various cases. The approach combines edge and texture features with SVM to classify rice types into five categories: Ipsala, Jasmine, Karacadag, Arborio, and Basmati. Experimental results demonstrate that SVM using Canny, Sobel, and Prewitt combined Gabor texture features outperforms the comparative methods. A comparative analysis based on accuracy scores using confusion matrices is conducted. Combining all feature edge methods, Canny, Sobel, and Prewitt with Gabor on SVM classification is the best model for rice object classification, achieving an accuracy of 96%.

articleTitle: Mitigating the risk induced by Online shopping by using Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The metaverse is revolutionizing the world of business, particularly in the area of virtual retail. It combines the convenience of online shopping with the tactile experience of browsing and socializing, giving a more personalized and store-like experience. This study focuses on the adoption of metaverse to enhance the luxury shopping experience for consumers. Trust is a major concern for consumers when shopping for luxury products online, but metaverse can help overcome this issue by providing a more engaging and authentic shopping experience. The study presents a framework for investigating the impact of metaverse on buying decisions and the performance of metaverse retailers. The findings will not only benefit virtual world retailers, but also retailers across all channels who can learn from new ways to differentiate their in-store experience. The adoption of metaverse can change business models and develop new marketing strategies, ultimately leading to increased sales and improved customer experience.

articleTitle: Alignment of Chan's Supply Value chain Waste Management Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Economy circulation can extend product cycle life, efficiency in using (extracting) natural resources, reduce waste generated from the production process and use recycled products as an increase in state revenue. The amount of waste does not show that the pattern of supply chain management in waste management is still not optimal, and the management of organic, inorganic waste (plastic, glass, wood, etc.) to hazardous and toxic waste (B3) which causes pollution, increases emissions impact on human health and the environment. Prevention to reduce excessive consumption patterns, waste management with the 3R pattern (reduce, reuse, and recycle), bio-physical-chemical processes for turning waste into new products, and waste incineration processes. Implementation of the Integrated Circular Economy System of waste in Indonesia with several stages of separating the waste into several waste groups, waste collection, waste transportation, waste treatment, and final waste treatment. Data collection in the form of data sets in the process of artificial intelligence or data mining for descriptive analysis, diagnostic analysis to find out the root of the problem and the background that occurs, predictive analysis to predict what will happen in the future, predictive analysis which is carried out at the latest and requires 4.0 technology supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT) which is integrated with information systems in waste management to be able to improve people's welfare, reduce waste from upstream / households and provide government input to make policy technical, budgeting, operational efficiency, optimization of TPA and garbage transportation system.

articleTitle: Fintech Digital Marketing Strategy to Increase User Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Fintech is one of the rapidly growing industries in Indonesia. This study aims to analyze the company's user acquisition journey and digital marketing strategy to compete in the Indonesian fintech market. This company is an international consumer finance provider with operations in eight countries. The authors collected qualitative data and analyzed the data using the IFE and EFE matrix methods and SWOT analysis. The results of the research state that the visibility of the company digital marketing properties, such as websites and mobile apps, still needs to be increased to increase the number of users. Therefore, the authors developed a digital marketing strategy action plan for the company. This strategy proved effective in achieving the research objectives. The digital marketing strategies implemented are SEO, SEM, ASO, and CRM.

articleTitle: Mammogram Breast Cancer Classification Based on Deep-Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Based on WHO’s data, breast cancer is one of the most deadly diseases that has claimed many victims, especially women. This disease begins with the presence of an undetected and eventually turns into malignant (cancer). This happens due to ignorance of the importance of having a medical check-up even though in good health. Doctors and researchers can prevent the development of tumor cells through treatment that begins with radiological examinations to identify the possibility of a person being affected by this disease. One of the most frequently used techniques is Mammography. This technique can detect the presence of tumor cells using advanced technology and several methods in displaying the patient’s diagnostic results on low-dose X-rays in the form of mammogram images. The technology is inseparable from the methods used to identify the presence of tumor cells. In this study, we have proposed the CNN method based on the deep-CNN model to identify mammogram images in the detection of breast cancer cells with average evaluation results in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, and f-measure on mammogram image datasets of 99.52%, 99.72%, 99.31%, 99.72%, and 99.5%. These results showed that this method has a good performance in breast cancer detection.

articleTitle: AlexNet Architecture Based Convolution Neural Network for Realtime Audio to Text Translator of Bisindo Hand Sign
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Deafness is a condition that results in the loss of hearing function, hindering the reception of information such as oral communication that relies on auditory senses. Consequently, individuals with hearing impairment experience communication barriers and may have limited or no ability to respond. One solution is the use of sign language. In Indonesia, there are two known sign languages: Sibi and Bisindo. Both serve the same function but differ in their style of movement and expression. Bisindo is considered more flexible as it conveys meaning based on the Indonesian language. However, the universal understanding of this language solution is still limited among many people. Therefore, a program is needed to facilitate translation between deaf individuals who use sign language and their counterparts who do not communicate through sign language. CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) is a deep learning algorithm used for training visual input data recognition by computer systems. There are various CNN-based architectures, and one of them is AlexNet. Based on the author's testing, the AlexNet architecture proves to be suitable for real-time sign language translation. The evaluation of the system involved 7,800 datasets and 520 testing instances, with an average accuracy of 468 correct translations. When averaged, the system achieved a 90% accuracy rate, representing a 100% increase in accuracy compared to previous approaches.

articleTitle: Big Data, Computer, and Technology in Language Studies: The Potentials of Sketch Engine in Indonesia’s Research
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The emergence of the personal computer and internet in the last quarter of the 20th century has triggered the development of corpus linguistic studies that enable researchers to investigate big data in synchronic and diachronic settings. Scholars have developed Corpus tools to provide linguistic analysis features such as word lists, keywords, collocations, and concordances. In 2003, a lexicographer named Adam Kilgariff developed Sketch Engine, which provides more than 700 text corpora in monolingual and multilingual forms and enables users to create their corpus by crawling the data online or uploading the compiled corpus themselves. In the Indonesian context, Sketch Engine has yet to be used widely, even though this tool provides a promising opportunity in language research. This paper discusses 1) the linguistic features available in Sketch Engine, 2) recent language research articles utilizing Sketch Engine, and 3) possible opportunities and barriers for Indonesia’s research. A conceptual and systematic review of corpus linguistics and Sketch Engine is provided to reach the objectives. The analysis found that Indonesian researchers have not contributed yet to the Indonesian corpus development in Sketch Engine. Possible barriers are as follows: 1) the subscription charge, 2) the unfamiliarity of the tool in corpus linguistic publication in Indonesia, and 3) the lack of understanding and application of corpus linguistics in Indonesian academia. Considering Indonesia as a multicultural country, vast opportunities in micro- and macro-linguistic studies will be beneficial to improve the research quality in the Indonesian context.

articleTitle: From Celebrity Endorsement and E-WOM to Purchase Intention: A Moderator Model Examining Negative Publicity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Using celebrity endorsements to raise awareness of products and services has given rise to electronic word of mouth (eWOM) and is currently a concern of many industries. However, the negative publicity impact of endorsements also influences purchase intentions. This study aims to analyze the role of celebrity endorsement and eWOM in influencing the purchase intention of local fashion products. Additionally, examine the impact of negative publicity as a mediator. The quantitative research method uses a questionnaire as a data collection tool. The research questionnaire was distributed online through social media platforms. The research sample is 200 and selected purposively. Hypothesis testing uses Partial Least Square-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). This research has proven that celebrity endorsement and eWOM positively and significantly impact local fashion products' purchase intention. In addition, this research also found that negative publicity significantly moderated the relationship between celebrity endorsement and the purchase intention of local fashion products. Theoretical and practical implications for researchers and practitioners regarding using celebrity endorsers to improve company performance have been discussed.

articleTitle: The Effect of Technological Capabilities and Social Media Usage on Export Performance with Competitive Advantage as Intervening Variable on SMEs in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study empirically investigates the relationship between technological capability and social media usage on the export performance of garment SMEs in Indonesia, along with the mediating effect of competitive advantage. To scrutinize the data gathered from questionnaires administered to 138 small and medium-sized garment enterprises, the PLS-SEM analysis was conducted. The findings of this study reveal that technology has a direct influence on improving export performance, but social media does not, however, the full mediating effect of competitive advantage is found in the relationship. Finally, this study contributes to filling the gap of previous research by incorporating competitive advantage as a mediating variable and enhancing the role of RDT and SPT.

articleTitle: Architecture development of middleware and API for IOT-based Red Onion farming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: IoT plays a crucial role in transforming the agricultural industry by offering diverse use cases starting from crop monitoring and precision farming to yield optimization. The fundamental reason why the agricultural community benefits immensely from IoT is due to its capacity to gather real-time data straight from their fields. Farming requires considerable attention, and wireless sensor networks enable farmers to deploy IoT devices throughout various parts of their farm so they can obtain information on soil moisture levels, temperature, humidity, among other essential parameters that are integral for effective agriculture management. This gathered data empowers farmers with accurate weather forecasts through machine learning techniques which assist them in making informed decisions related to planting or harvesting of crops - vital components critical for successful outcomes towards better yields. Moreover, middleware architectures/APIs developed specifically for IOT-based red onion farming utilize cloud computing services wherein these enlightening patterns generated get stored safely using analytics tools &automated systems. These intensify insights derived as it simplifies accessing important metrics aiding ease while analyzing historical trends advantageously helping make prudent future course corrective measures concerning planting/harvesting schedules based entirely on solid empirical evidence combined with artificial intelligence ensuring unprecedented efficiency gains and higher returns than previously achievable without technology guidance.

articleTitle: Delve deep into End-To-End Automatic Speech Recognition Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) has experienced significant advancements in recent years, with end-to-end approaches emerging as a promising paradigm shift. Unlike traditional ASR systems that rely on a pipeline of separate components, end-to-end models aim to directly transcribe speech inputs into text using deep learning architectures. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study on end-to-end ASR models. We review various architectures employed in end-to-end ASR, including recurrent neural networks (RNNs), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and transformer-based models. We explore different training methodologies, loss functions, and optimization algorithms used in end-to-end ASR. Additionally, we discuss large-scale datasets commonly used for training and evaluate the performance of end-to-end models using established evaluation metrics such as word error rate (WER). Furthermore, we analyze the strengths and weaknesses of end-to-end ASR models, highlight their applications in real-world scenarios, and discuss open challenges and future directions. By providing this comprehensive study, we aim to facilitate a deeper understanding of end-to-end ASR models and their potential for driving advancements in speech recognition technology.

articleTitle: White Bread Mold Detection using K-Means Clustering Based on Grey Level Co-Occurrence Matrix and Region of Interest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This research paper presents a bread mold identification system that utilizes digital image processing techniques, specifically K-means clustering and thresholding, to accurately detect and classify mold-infected areas on bread. The system aims to provide valuable information regarding the safety of consuming mold-contaminated bread, enabling consumers to make informed decisions and reduce the risk of health issues associated with consuming mold-infested bread. the K-means clustering algorithm for mold classification, considering factors such as the number of iterations and the distance metric within the feature space to determine its accuracy. The GLCM feature extraction technique is employed to extract texture information from bread images, encompassing features such as standard deviation (110.62), contrast (1.46), energy, and homogeneity (0.96 and 0.77, respectively). Experimental results demonstrate that the Euclidean Distance yielded the highest result of 72.73, the Cosine Distance obtained the highest result of 8.25, and the City Block Distance obtained the highest result of 92.11. These findings showcase the effectiveness of the system in accurately detecting and classifying mold-infected areas on bread, thereby aiding in ensuring food safety and reducing health risks for consumers.

articleTitle: Assessing the Perception of Consumers Towards Smart Tourism Destination
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: City tourism is an important aspect of tourism and contributes significantly to overall tourism-generated revenue. But there is great competitiveness among various destinations and cities in India. So, there is a need for different integrated approaches to attract tourists. Urban cultures comprising the freshly built infrastructure and a rich cultural legacy in tangible and intangible forms become an emerging attraction if guided by smart technology. In this favour, tourism in Jaipur city in India sets a perfect example, as mentioned by t Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs in 2022. The paper focuses on consumers' perception of smart tourism, where heritage, culture, urbanization and the issues that seem out their interaction, quoting Jaipur city as an example. Secondary data from different sources have been analyzed quantitatively and qualitatively in the context of perception, urbanization and traditional heritage. The cumulative effect of various concerns that emerged due to messy urbanization has changed tourists' perceptions. With urbanization, the tourism flow in Jaipur city has improved numerically, but the city's share in total travellers of the state has decreased. The government is working on about 140 cities nationwide under the smart city mission from 2019-2023. Therefore, a different dimensional approach is needed to implement the current policies and programs of urban development, mainstreaming the issues of cultural heritage conservation. This paper highlights the importance of smart tourism in branding cities as emerging destinations by implementing technological factors at various stages.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Multi Class Support Vector Machine vs Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Brain Tumor Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Multi SVM has long been one of the popular methods in classification, while DCNN has recently gained significant attention in image processing and pattern recognition. This research evaluates the effectiveness of Multi Class Support Vector Machine (M-SVM) and Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) techniques in classifying brain tumors. A dataset of 2660 3D medical images with dimensions 227 x 227 x 3; including Glioma, Meningioma, and Pituitary tumors, has been partitioned into distinct sets for both training and testing purposes. DCNN approach achieves excellent accuracy in identifying tumor names, with a training accuracy of 97.8% and 100% success rate in 9 experiments. The Multi SVM method demonstrates relatively good accuracy, with training accuracies ranging from 70% to 90% based on different kernel functions. These findings provide valuable insights for selecting appropriate methods in brain tumor classification and encourage further exploration of hybrid Multi SVM-DCNN approaches to enhance accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Finance Industry and the Talent Strategy: Case from Greater Jakarta Area
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Considering the moderating influence of gender, this study aims to provide insight into the levels of work stress, work-family conflict, and turnover intention in the banking sector, specifically in major cities like Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi. It aims to investigate the connection between these variables and how gender affects that connection. The participants in this study were selected from various sectors within the finance industry in Indonesia, including B2C and B2B banks, P2P lending, e-wallet, conventional/digital banks, and state-owned or private-owned banks, insurance in Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi area. The data was collected using an online questionnaire distributed to potential participants via email and social media. The methodology used in this study involves evaluating the proposed model with Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). This research revealed that work-related stress and work-family conflict strongly influence the desire to leave. Another conclusion is that gender influences the links between work stress, work-family conflict, and intention to leave. Workplace stress and work-family conflict positively impact females' intentions to leave their jobs. However, only work-family conflict and not work stress significantly affect guys' decision to leave their jobs. The results of this investigation indicate that organizations can reduce turnover intention and enhance employee well-being through stress management programs and work-life balance initiatives. It is important to consider gender differences and implement gender-specific interventions to address male and female employees’ unique needs. By prioritizing these strategies, organizations can create a supportive environment that promotes employee retention and job satisfaction in the finance industry.

articleTitle: Effect of EWOM Credibility in Social Networking Site (SNS) on Brand Image and Its Impact on Online Purchase Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This research identifies indicators that affect the credibility of eWOM on social networking sites on brand image which will impact on online consumer purchase intentions. Combining Theory of Consumer Behavior with the theoretical results of previous literature related to eWOM, brand image, and consumer purchase intention. Collecting 180 respondents in the city of Jakarta using simple random sampling and questionnaires. Used structural equation modeling (SEM) for analysis and partial least squares (PLS) for empirical testing. This study aids marketers in understanding how eWOM credibility impacts brand image and consumer online purchase intention.

articleTitle: Managing Talent in Digital Financing Industry: Do Male and Female Employees Differ?
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: The relationship between psychological issues and companies is becoming increasingly important in Indonesia, particularly for the new generation, especially in the technology and financing industries. Work stress is a type of psychological issue that can have a significant impact on employee well-being and job performance. The previous study found that females were more likely than males to report experiencing work-related stress and were more likely to report symptoms of anxiety and depression due to this stress. A total of 50 respondents was collected from the digital financing industry to investigate the effect of work stress and work-family conflict on turnover intention. From respondent data processed using SPSS statistical software and analysis results to show important differences in characteristics and behaviour between the two gender groups and using the collected survey data, simple regression and moderated regression analysis found that work stress and work-family conflict positively and significantly impact turnover intention. When the mode is split based on gender, this research found that female employees influence turnover intention (37.4%) while male employees are not (16.6%). From the results of this study, it is hoped that it can help companies, especially HR Leaders, in formulating policies to reduce the potential level of turnover within the organization.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Demographic and Psychographic Variables in Shaping Consumer Behavior towards Online Food Delivery Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: During the past decade, the restaurant industry is expanding at a fast speed and will continue in the future. With an annual growth rate of 7%, the Indian restaurant industry is worth Rs. 75000 crore. As the lifestyle of people changed, they have a lack of time in the fast-paced time of today. This problem has been solved with the advancement in the field of e-commerce where customers receive their products at their doorstep. Development of technology in various fields leads Indian food and restaurant service towards online food ordering businesses with the help of various self or third-party online food delivery portals. The Indian online food delivery market is anticipated to be an opportunity of $17.02 billion by 2023, registering an annual growth rate of 16 percent. The present research focuses on the study of data obtained from users of online food delivery services via an online questionnaire. The objective of the analysis is to analyse the demographic factors influencing the choice of OFD services and the consumption pattern of OFD services. The sample size consists of 256 people aged 18 years and over. The study reveals customer pattern of using OFD services and explore the association of demographic factors with service consuming behavior.

articleTitle: The Role of Information Technology in Changing Business Models to Increase Competitive Advantage of Ultra Micro Financing Institutions: Case Study of Institution ABC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Many organizations have been starting to modify their business models to more focus on digital technology in recent years because digital technology has become a key factor to running a business. This modification is by applying technology to every part of the business. There have been many studies on the role of IT (information technology) is changing business models. However, the research would focus on analyzing the role of IT and its influence on changes in the business model canvas to be the digital business model with the Morphology Ontology approach, especially in government microfinance institutions in Indonesia. ABC is one of the organizations that successfully applied technology to support its business strategy by modifying the business model. We use a qualitative method, we compare the business model in the study case with similar business models in other countries, and then we conducted some interviews to gather the data needed. We evaluate eight drivers in the Business Model Morphology Ontology Elements and described explicitly the alignment between the business model and IT adoption. Our results show digital transformation business model of ABC and the IT impact in ABC new business model, and ultimately have an impact on increasing competitive advantage in terms of client intimacy.

articleTitle: Examining the Determinants of Continuance Intention to Use Online Food Delivery Service Applications: Evidence from Manila
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: This study was conducted to examine the determinants of Continuance Intention to use Online Food Delivery Service Applications in Manila City during the transition from a pandemic to an endemic state of the coronavirus disease. The present study is carried out to learn about the conceptual framework that consists of six constructs such as habit, perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, variety, attitude, and continuance intention to use. The study employed a quantitative method and 232 respondents participated in the study. The online questionnaires were distributed using a convenient sampling technique. A structural equation model was presented to test the hypotheses. The Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) was used in this study to explore the variables influencing users' continuance intentions to use Online Food Delivery Services. Results revealed that habit, perceived usefulness, perceived usefulness, and variety of food choices affect users' attitudes toward using online food delivery services, and attitude is the most important factor in determining whether users will continuance intention to use the apps. These findings have managerial and theoretical implications that are beneficial to the online food delivery service industry.

articleTitle: Citrus Limon L. Ripeness Identification Using Feature Extraction of Mean RGB, HSV, LBP and K-Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Citrus Limon L. (Lemon) is a type of fruit that is currently widely consumed, because it contains abundant vitamin C, fiber, and antioxidants. This fruit have high potential in the agribusiness sector and is widely cultivated by traditional farmers. However, during harvest time, traditional farmers generally still use manual methods using the human eye in distinguishing the maturity level of lemons which is less efficient because it has a low accuracy. Digital image processing is one solution to this problem. In the research on the classification of lemon maturity levels using digital image processing with the feature extraction method of the Mean RGB, HSV, and LBP methods and the K-Nearest Neighbor classification algorithm in this study, a total of 120 lemon images were used which were divided into 80 training image data and 40 image data. testing. The results of model performance measurements in the form of the highest accuracy level in the Mean RGB method of 100%, the highest accuracy in the HSV method of 98%, and the highest accuracy in the LBP method of 82.5%.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a form of complication of diabetes mellitus in which high insulin levels eventually result in damage to the blood vessels of the retina of the eye, especially in light-sensitive tissues. Diabetic retinopathy can cause blindness if it is still untreated. To detect diabetic retinopathy, some doctors are evaluating using digital color images to see the retinal fundus to determine if there is any presence of lesions or vascular abnormalities on the eyeball. Looking at those conditions, this paper will summarize many of the papers which had innovated some detection of the emersion of diabetic retinopathy automatically using deep learning concepts to make the detection way become more accessible and has a high level of accuracy. It also would have much more time-saving than doing it manually. This paper used a systematic literature review based on several papers from the Google Scholar search engine with the keywords which must contain "diabetic retinopathy" and "deep learning". This paper aims to assist in the detection of DR using deep learning and evaluate the literature from various papers to obtain important information in a more concise manner regarding the most widely used datasets and the details, how deep learning algorithms work and detect DR, as well as make a comprehensive evaluation of the performance of different deep learning models and bring up an overview and design. It will focus on key metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and AUC (Area Under the Curve), which are common indicators for assessing the effectiveness of detection algorithms. This paper found that the MESSIDOR is the most often used dataset. This paper also found that the most widely used model and the highest percentage of accuracy or AUC is ResNet-50. The ResNet-50 model produces accuracy figures that are always over 95%

articleTitle: Movie Sentiment Analysis Using Data Augmentation And LSTM-Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication (iSemantic)
abstract: Research in the field of data mining, especially text-based, is growing with the discovery of new methods that have good performance. Sentiment analysis is a field of research that is still widely studied in text classification. Various approaches, including Machine Learning, have been tried in sentiment analysis research, but as the dataset grows, these methods do not produce optimal accuracy performance. The Deep Learning method is a solution that is often used by researchers to produce maximum performance on large datasets, but in some studies, if the number of datasets is limited, the training model cannot be carried out optimally. As a solution, data augmentation is an approach that can be used to increase the quantity of datasets so as to encourage better performance of a model. This study uses a sentiment analysis dataset regarding various films on Twitter, but with a limited amount of data, so a data augmentation approach is needed to increase the quantity. Text-based data augmentation techniques combined with the Deep Learning approach, namely the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTM) methods are the approaches we propose in this study. RNN LSTM has the ability to Handling Long-Term Dependencies and Effective in Sequence-to-Sequence Tasks so that the performance of the model on the sentiment analysist will be more optimal The results show that the proposed model has succeeded in classifying the sentiment analysis dataset for film reviews by showing a model accuracy rate of 70.45%.
